card.name: Modal words before fetal harm warnings
card.fires_on: The word right before a fetal-harm statement in pregnancy warnings, such as can, may, or potential after 'during pregnancy' or 'apprised of the'.

modes.label: can/may before harm
modes.description: A modal verb after a drug name or 'during pregnancy' that introduces embryo-fetal harm.
modes.example: Exposure to ZIIHERA during pregnancy<< can>> cause embryo-fetal harm.

modes.label: potential hazard
modes.description: The word 'potential' in 'apprised of the potential hazard/risk to the fetus'.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words meaning loss, damage or breaking, which fits harm to a fetus.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a pregnancy warning where the text is about to say the drug may harm the fetus.
